summary: Security re-gate after the Sprint B fix round. All four routed findings are FIXED. Each was proven by SQL as impersonated users inside one rolled-back transaction, and by reading the code. SEC2-01 (high, dev2): an EUR or XYZ item from sales or the accountant gets below_floor_price no_price. Switching an EUR->INR or USD->INR draft below the new floor gets below_floor_price 125.00, and the header stays unchanged. fn_quote_update_draft saves the whole edit or nothing. fn_quote_send re-derives the floor and catches a floor raised after the draft was saved (150.00). Another org's product gets bad_payload product_id, the same error as a random id, so no GST rate leaks. No order was created. SEC2-02 (high, dev2+dev1): supplied INQ, BUY, SMP and QTN numbers and a forged PI number are replaced by the next generated number, later inserts succeed, the counters advance, and changing buyer_code, quote_no or code is refused with permission denied. SEC2-03 (high, dev1+dev2): Plant's writes on buyers and buyer_contacts touch 0 rows or raise an RLS error, ORD-0002 stays overdue, and both server actions plus the pages refuse Plant. SEC2-04 (major, dev1): 25 open-redirect payloads produce 0 external navigations through safeInternalPath on the server, the client re-check and Next's URL resolution. No new blocker or high finding. ci:tenant-check, npm test (93/93), lint and typecheck all pass. The logged-in HTTP walkthrough is still blocked because there is no hosted Supabase.

usability_notes: The owner can still quote in a currency that has no price list, by design. Such an order is left out of the Home money tile, which sums INR and USD only. This is a product decision for dev2 and dev3, not a security issue.

Plant can still add notes and reminders on a buyer page (follow_ups with entity_type 'buyer' map to the buyers module). No money, terms or contacts change. This is a product decision; dev1 already raised it for QA.

SEC2-05 to SEC2-11 from review 2 were not assigned this round and were not re-verified. A side effect was seen: the G2-03 same-org parent checks now refuse another org's buyer on quotations and buyer_contacts, so SEC2-06 looks largely addressed.
